changes.title: API version 2026-10 is the latest stable; 2025-10 is retired (accessible until 2026-10-16) so callers pinned to it fall forward to the oldest supported version

source.quote: 2026-10 is the latest stable API version.

changes.title: API version 2027-01 is a release candidate and becomes stable on 2027-01-01; callers should test and then move to it

source.quote: 2027-01 is available as a release candidate for development testing until January 1, 2027, when it becomes stable:

changes.title: Segment query language functions in 2026-10 use MATCHES / NOT MATCHES instead of = true / = false, and named dates like 30_days_ago are deprecated for offsets such as -12m

source.quote: Segment query language functions now use `MATCHES` and `NOT MATCHES` instead of `= true` and `= false`, and function parameters take their own operators.

changes.title: CustomerPhoneNumber flat SMS marketing consent fields are deprecated in favour of the new smsMarketingConsent field (2026-10)

source.quote: The flat SMS marketing consent fields on `CustomerPhoneNumber` are deprecated, so plan to migrate existing integrations to `smsMarketingConsent`.

changes.title: Discounts can be part of Rollouts; read Discount.rollouts with the new read_rollouts access scope because startsAt/endsAt no longer describe availability alone

source.quote: Add the `read_rollouts` access scope and read `Discount.rollouts`, `Rollout` schedules, and effective traffic allocation alongside `startsAt` and `endsAt`

changes.title: ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION error removed from inventory quantity mutations and the InventorySetQuantitiesUserErrorCode enum

source.quote: The obsolete `ITEM_NOT_STOCKED_AT_LOCATION` error is removed from `InventoryAdjustQuantities`, `InventoryMoveQuantities`, and `InventorySetOnHandQuantities`, and from the `InventorySetQuantitiesUserErrorCode` enum.

changes.title: Changing an unfulfilled order's shipping address via orderUpdate or REST order update now recalculates taxes; re-query tax and totals afterwards

source.quote: Changing the shipping address on an unfulfilled order with `orderUpdate` or the REST Admin API order update endpoint now recalculates taxes for the new destination.

changes.title: DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule and the legacy PriceRule object removed; select discountTitle and discountCode instead

source.quote: The deprecated `priceRule` field is removed from `DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning`.

changes.title: SubscriptionContractCalculation API replaces SubscriptionDraft as the path for subscription contract edits; SubscriptionDraft stays but gets no new capabilities (action required)

source.quote: Migrate from `SubscriptionDraft`, which remains available but won't support these capabilities.

changes.title: OrderDisplayFulfillmentStatus can now return FULFILLMENT_NOT_REQUIRED instead of UNFULFILLED; handle the new enum value in exhaustive mappings

source.quote: Handle the new enum value if you exhaustively map fulfillment statuses.

changes.title: GraphQL Admin API now returns an error for queries filtering by a metafield not valid for filtering, instead of ignoring the predicate (action required before upgrading)

source.quote: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a `metafield` that isn't valid for filtering, instead of silently ignoring the predicate.

changes.title: ProductVariant.barcode is deprecated in favour of the ProductVariant.barcodes connection (up to 20 typed barcodes); barcode returns only the first entry

source.quote: `ProductVariant` now has a `barcodes` connection for up to 20 typed barcodes, and `ProductVariant.barcode` is deprecated.

changes.title: carrierServiceCreate and POST carrier_services.json no longer add rates to the General shipping profile; configure rates in a shipping profile

source.quote: Creating carrier services with `carrierServiceCreate` or `POST /admin/api/{version}/carrier_services.json` now registers only the service.

changes.title: Public apps must migrate to expiring offline access tokens by 2027-01-01 (delisting); Admin API requests with non-expiring offline tokens return HTTP 403 from 2027-04-01

source.quote: **April 1, 2027:** Affected Admin API requests using non-expiring offline access tokens return HTTP 403.

changes.title: New security features: client credentials access, Admin API IP allowlist (rejects requests from other IPs), and network_access section in shopify.app.toml (review whether your app is affected)

source.quote: List the IP addresses your servers use, and we'll reject Admin API requests from any other IP, even if it has a valid access token.

changes.title: Shopify Tax managed mode: marketCreate/marketUpdate reject non-default currencySettings and priceInclusions for US markets (all supported versions); publishing to Online Store/Headless/Hydrogen/Buy Button requires Shop channel; custom line item taxable deprecated in 2027-01 for productCategoryId

source.quote: the [`marketCreate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/marketCreate) and [`marketUpdate`](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/latest/mutations/marketUpdate) mutations now reject attempts to override required currency and tax-display defaults for affected markets.

changes.title: First sign-in to new customer accounts now sets Customer.state to ENABLED and sends customers/enable and customers/update webhooks (check apps that act on these)

source.quote: A customer's first sign-in to [customer accounts](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/customers/customer-accounts/new-customer-accounts) now sets [`Customer.state`]

changes.title: automaticDiscounts query and DiscountAutomaticConnection/Edge types removed in 2027-01; use discountNodes with method:automatic

source.quote: The deprecated `automaticDiscounts` query is removed, along with the `DiscountAutomaticConnection` and `DiscountAutomaticEdge` types.

changes.title: marketCurrencySettingsUpdate mutation and its payload/error types removed in 2027-01; use marketCreate and marketUpdate

source.quote: The `marketCurrencySettingsUpdate` mutation is removed, along with `MarketCurrencySettingsUpdatePayload`, `MarketCurrencySettingsUserError`, and `MarketCurrencySettingsUserErrorCode`.

changes.title: PRIVATE and PUBLIC_READ values removed from MetaobjectAdminAccess enum in 2027-01

source.quote: The obsolete `PRIVATE` and `PUBLIC_READ` values are removed from the `MetaobjectAdminAccess` enum.

changes.title: Collection metafieldInteger condition inputs removed in 2027-01; use metafieldInt and send integer values as strings

source.quote: The `metafieldInteger` collection source condition inputs and the `CollectionSourceInclusionConditionMetafieldInteger` types are removed.

changes.title: Third-party tax apps receive Global IDs (GIDs) instead of numeric IDs in tax calculation requests and tax summary webhook payloads in 2027-01

source.quote: Third-party tax apps now receive Global IDs instead of numeric IDs for customers, companies, products, variants, line items, and other entities in tax calculation requests and tax summary webhook payloads.

changes.title: @shopify/shopify-api 15.0.0 removes eventId and resourceId from events webhook deliveries (also affects app-remix and app-react-router authenticate.webhook); use webhookId to dedupe

source.quote: d641a62: Remove `eventId` and `resourceId` from events webhooks

changes.title: @shopify/shopify-api 15.0.1 sets HttpOnly on OAuth state and session cookies by default (behaviour change; pass httpOnly: false to opt out)

source.quote: Set the `HttpOnly` flag on cookies by default, including the OAuth state and session cookies, so browser JavaScript can no longer read them.

changes.title: @shopify/shopify-api 14.0.0 requires Node.js 22+, removes webhook subTopic (use filters; metaobjects webhooks need filters), tightens GraphQL client types and hardens App Proxy validation

source.quote: Require Node.js 22 or later. Node.js 20 is no longer supported.

changes.title: @shopify/shopify-api 13.0.0 removes customShopDomains (use domainTransformations), drops API versions 2022-10 through 2024-07, and makes WebhookFields a discriminated union on webhookType

source.quote: **BREAKING CHANGE**: Removed `customShopDomains` configuration parameter. Use `domainTransformations` instead, which provides both validation and transformation capabilities.

changes.title: REST Admin API is legacy; new public apps must use the GraphQL Admin API, and newer features are GraphQL-only

source.quote: The REST Admin API is a legacy API as of October 1, 2024.
